frontier.hypothesis: The single missing addiu is decided in register allocation, not in C spelling: target's &D_800F1AF4 pseudo is hoisted but denied a hard register, so reload rematerialises it from REG_EQUIV at each of its three uses.
frontier.mechanism: global.c find_reg weighs an allocno's benefit against the save/restore cost of claiming a fresh callee-save register; a 3-reference pointer with a function-long live range sits right at that boundary. In our builds it always wins the register (157-159 insns, scores 11-22); in target it evidently loses it.

Every C-level spelling is already dead (s2: 4, s3: 6), so do not spend the session on more spellings.
